note: Lou's ruling, 21/10/2026: where an ICB names no current digital lead on a standing page of its own site, the Hub shows the most recent digital lead named in that ICB's own published board papers, annual report, FOI response or news (2022 onwards), starred, with the document and its date, and 'Not confirmed current; check before contacting'. Each entry below was read in the named document on 21/10/2026 and the quote is the line it was read from. Hosted on the ICB's own domain, or on its system/partnership site linked from the ICB's meetings page (QF7 syics.co.uk, QGH hwics.org.uk, QWO wypartnership.co.uk, QUA its former domain blackcountryics.org.uk). QE1's site was suspended (403) on 21/10/2026, so it is unread. Searched and none named from 2022 onwards on the ICB's own site: QK1, QRL, S1Y5D, S9B9J, Z9B2Z (roles named without a person). Deputies, trust officers and cluster-only roles are not used (QVV's deputy CIO, QT1's 2026 cluster digital director, which could not be read in its document here). Refresh this file by hand; never from LinkedIn or trade press.
